remarks: Exceptional Single-Family Colonial in coveted Westover neighborhood. Tucked away at the end of a cul-de-sac this stunning colonial checks every box for space, style, setting, & updates! With a perfect blend of formal & informal living areas, this home is built for today's lifestyle-whether you're entertaining guests or stretching out with family. Main level features beautifully updated eat-in kitchen with granite counters, stainless steel appliances, & tons of counter space & storage. Direct access out to large screened in porch with string lights creating a very cool vibe for seamless indoor-outdoor living! Step down to a stone patio for BBQ's or fire pit. Off other side of porch is a nice fenced in area with access to laundry/mud room & 1/2 bath. Additional family room with wood burning fireplace & formal dining room round out 1st floor. Upstairs, the huge primary suite has 2 walk-in closets & updated bathroom with glass stalled shower. 3 additional bedrooms are generously sized, offering comfort & versatility. Need more room? The finished lower level includes two bonus spaces ready for any need, home office, gym, playroom, media room -you name it- plus loads of storage & built in shelving to help keep all that clutter organized. Hardwood floors on main living floors, central air, level yard for play, all in one of Stamford's premier locations complete the package. This home offers the space you need, the updates you want, & the neighborhood you've been searching for
